perFrameCode: // Wipe out blacks and whites using Boolean algebra.
q1 = if(downbummer,1-q1,q1); // Shift lower triangle on B/W
q4 = if(upbummer,1-q4,q4);   // Shift upper triangle on B/W
// - Periodic trigger to change second sine period
sq1 = q1; sq2 = q2; sq3 = q3;
sq4 = q4; sq5 = q5; sq6 = q6;
